searchText: I had a crack at implementing an EIP4788 verification proof generation and verification for the BeaconState. Does the leaf index need to be enforced by the smart contract verification? For example: I want to prove a particular value in the BeaconState (`finalized_checkpoint` has value `epoch`). A user can provide the epoch and a Path to the BeaconRoot but my concern is they could provide any value and a path to the root and it would pass verification. My workaround to this was to enforce the leaf index value. Is this a valid approach? Also can the leafIndex for the `finalized_checkpoint` , `epoch` change based on other values in the tree? e.g. new validator deposited Code here: https://github.com/rzmahmood/beaconstate-proving-kit/blob/main/smartcontracts/src/FinalizedCheckpointTracker.sol Edit: Ok my new understanding is that we need to prove intermediate state (containers) to simplify the gindexes, however, it is not necessary to prove intermediate states if we don't care to simplify the gindex

I had a crack at implementing an EIP4788 verification proof generation and verification for the BeaconState. 

Does the leaf index need to be enforced by the smart contract verification?  

For example:  I want to prove a particular value in the BeaconState (`finalized_checkpoint` has  value `epoch`). A user can provide the epoch and a Path to the BeaconRoot but my concern is they could provide any value and a path to the root and it would pass verification. My workaround to this was to enforce the leaf index value. Is this a valid approach?

Also can the leafIndex for the `finalized_checkpoint` , `epoch`  change based on other values in the tree? e.g. new validator deposited

Code here: https://github.com/rzmahmood/beaconstate-proving-kit/blob/main/smartcontracts/src/FinalizedCheckpointTracker.sol

Edit: Ok my new understanding is that we need to prove intermediate state (containers) to simplify the gindexes, however, it is not necessary to prove intermediate states if we don't care to simplify the gindex
